label: Zenteiq

dataset.output: vorticity at t = 11-20, one step at a time

protocol.loss: relative L2 per sample and step, summed over the batch and the teacher-forced steps

metric: relative L2 per test sample over the 10 frames of the autoregressive rollout (test_l2_full of exp_ns.py)
weights: last epoch (no validation split, so no epoch selection)

provenance.converted_from: transolver_ns_v2_parity/transolver_ns_params.bytes (weights after the last epoch, 499) and its loss_curve.csv
provenance.trained_by: an earlier standalone training script, same recipe, data, model and seed, with the PyTorch-reference numerics (exact GELU, LayerNorm eps 1e-5, torch Conv2d init, beta1 cycling)
provenance.training_device: NVIDIA RTX PRO 6000 Blackwell Max-Q (cuda:0); the device field above is where this conversion ran
provenance.note: Trained before this benchmark's train.py existed. Its weight init kept the (256, 1) output-projection kernel at Flax's default (the orthogonality check's rank-1 false positive, 9 kernels kept); train.py reinitialises it like every other Linear (8 kept). Otherwise the same recipe, data, model and seed.
provenance.timing_note: Trained on one RTX PRO 6000 Blackwell GPU shared with up to five other jobs; per-epoch times are not a controlled measure.
